retrievalProfile.description: A distressed, multi-layered vintage layout featuring bold, weathered block typography over a textured paper background with vinyl record motifs.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition framed by a solid border, utilizing a central stack of large, distressed sans-serif type. The background is a yellowed, fibrous paper texture featuring a horizontal crease. Vinyl records and paper sleeves are partially visible at the edges, creating a collage effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale central typography dominates the visual hierarchy
Distressed textures unify the type and background elements
Vinyl record fragments frame the central text block
A solid outer border contains the textured inner composition
coreInvariants: Horizontal fold or crease line across the center
Distressed, weathered treatment on all display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized text block occupying 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest word in the center, rendered in a contrasting dark blue.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan through the stacked text, ending at the detailed list at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with texture and type.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Red and Navy Blue (Primary Type)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, desaturated tones to simulate age and wear.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright neon or pure white

letterConstructionRules: Simulated ink bleed and weathering on edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical text orientation for secondary descriptors
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking different weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the primary text.
Provides the necessary clean skeleton for further distressing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a dark blue border. Inside, a yellowed, fibrous paper texture with a horizontal crease. Place partial vinyl records and paper sleeves at the corners and edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked, extra-bold condensed sans-serif text in the center. Use red for the top and bottom lines and navy blue for the middle line. Apply a heavy grunge/distressed texture to the text to match the background.

verificationChecks: Is the background a yellowed paper texture?
Is there a visible horizontal crease?
Are the fonts bold and condensed?

postGenerationChecks: Check for the horizontal crease line
Verify the fibrous texture of the paper
Ensure text looks stamped or printed, not digitally clean
Confirm the presence of the solid outer border
recipe.reuseFormula: Distressed Block Type + Fibrous Paper Texture + Vinyl Motifs + Solid Border Frame
